paragraphs: Public Safety Testing runs hiring and testing programs for public safety agencies and for the candidates who want to work in them. It was formed in 2000 to help local governments build and maintain eligibility lists for firefighter, police officer, deputy sheriff, corrections officer and 9-1-1 dispatcher positions. Alongside testing, the firm sells recruiting, human resource and investigative services.

A candidate completes one online application, takes one written exam and one physical ability test, fills out a single Personal History Statement, and has scores sent to one or many departments. Testing is continuous rather than annual, with hundreds of local testing opportunities each year across the United States. Agency programs also cover advertising and professional recruiting assistance, application intake processing, investigations, promotional testing and executive services. Candidates and departments see test scores in real time.

Hundreds of public safety agencies in the Pacific Northwest and beyond contract for pre-employment testing, investigative and promotional services. The site marks 25 years of the company. It describes partnering with hundreds of departments and serving tens of thousands of candidates. The company identifies itself as a veteran and servicemember owned business. It is registered with the Washington Department of Veterans Affairs.

quote.text: To support public safety agencies in their goal to hire and develop great employees and provide candidates with the best path to rewarding careers.
